description: Discover the 2026 Nissan Rogue SV, a versatile SUV that combines style, technology, and performance for a confident driving experience. With just under 15,000 miles, this used model presents a sleek Gun Metallic exterior complemented by a charcoal interior, offering a refined look and comfortable ride. Powered by a turbocharged 1.5-liter three-cylinder engine delivering 201 horsepower and 225 lb-ft of torque, paired with a smooth CVT with Xtronic transmission, it ensures efficient performance with up to 35 mpg highway and 28 mpg city. Its AWD system provides added stability on every road, making it an ideal choice for daily commuting and weekend adventures. The vehicle's four-door layout seats five passengers and features key comfort and convenience amenities designed to enhance your driving experience.Equipped with a comprehensive suite of driver-assist features, the Nissan Rogue SV offers peace of mind on every journey. Adaptive cruise control, blind spot monitor, and lane keep assist work together to help maintain safety and control, while collision warning, pre-collision systems, and automatic emergency braking at intersections provide added security. A backup camera, cross traffic alert, and cornering brake control further enhance situational awareness. Convenience is at your fingertips with keyless entry, push start, and an automatic auto-locking system, complemented by electronic parking brake and rear seat reminder. These features make every trip safer and more effortless, reflecting Nissans focus on security and driver confidence.2026 Nissan Rogue Safety and Security FeaturesThis SUV is equipped with advanced safety technologies including automatic emergency braking at intersections and junctions, ensuring rapid response to potential hazards. The check rear seat reminder promotes passenger safety, especially for children. Dual knee airbags, four-wheel ABS, and cornering brake control add to its safety credentials. Power door locks with anti-lockout and auto-locking functions provide security and convenience, while the pre-collision warning system helps prevent accidents. An auto-off electronic parking brake further enhances safety, making this Rogue a dependable choice for families and daily drivers alike.2026 Nissan Rogue Entertainment and Technology FeaturesStay connected and entertained with NissanConnect compatibility, allowing seamless smartphone integration through Apple CarPlay and Android Auto. Hands-free voice-operated phone calls and radio provide easy access to your favorite apps and music, while the 8-inch touchscreen infotainment display offers intuitive control. The vehicle features six speakers, USB auxiliary input, and touch-screen radio for a rich audio experience. Smart device app functions include engine start, and electronic messaging assistance with read and voice-operated options keep you connected safely on the go. These features combine to deliver a modern, user-friendly technology experience tailored for today's driver.2026 Nissan Rogue Performance FeaturesThis Rogue offers intelligent performance with auto start/stop functionality that helps improve fuel efficiency and reduce emissions. The on-demand four-wheel-drive system provides optimal traction and stability, adapting to changing road conditions effortlessly. Designed for reliable performance, it balances power and economy, making it suitable for everyday driving and longer trips alike.
